# OKF trust & discovery full chain: verify -> facets -> trust/stale filters -> show -> browse read-only
exec sh -c 'pinax init vault --title Vault --json > init.json'
validate-json-envelope init.json
validate-clean-stdout init.json

# Refresh the index once so later --lazy-index off assertions have a baseline
exec sh -c 'pinax index refresh --vault vault --json > refresh.json'
validate-json-envelope refresh.json

# note verify: fail-closed without actor (no identity configured here)
! exec sh -c 'pinax note verify notes/architecture/auth-design.md --vault vault --json > actor_missing.json'
grep actor_required actor_missing.json

# note verify: append a human verification event
exec sh -c 'pinax note verify notes/architecture/auth-design.md --actor human:ye --note reviewed --vault vault --json > verify.json'
validate-json-envelope verify.json
validate-clean-stdout verify.json
grep '"trust":"human"' verify.json
grep '"idempotent":"false"' verify.json

# verify idempotency: same actor same day does not append again
exec sh -c 'pinax note verify notes/architecture/auth-design.md --actor human:ye --vault vault --json > verify2.json'
validate-json-envelope verify2.json
grep '"idempotent":"true"' verify2.json
grep '"writes":"false"' verify2.json

# search --facets: full match set counts with trust and fresh groups
exec sh -c 'pinax search auth --facets --vault vault --json > facets.json'
validate-json-envelope facets.json
validate-clean-stdout facets.json
grep '"facets"' facets.json
grep '"value":"human"' facets.json
grep '"value":"stale"' facets.json

# agent output carries facets.* and result trust/fresh fields
exec sh -c 'pinax search auth --facets --vault vault --agent > facets_agent.txt'
validate-agent-format facets_agent.txt
grep 'facets.trust.human=1' facets_agent.txt
grep 'facets.fresh.stale=1' facets_agent.txt
grep 'result.1.trust=' facets_agent.txt
grep 'result.1.fresh=' facets_agent.txt

# trust filter narrows to a subset
exec sh -c 'pinax search auth --trust human --vault vault --json > trust.json'
validate-json-envelope trust.json
grep 'notes/architecture/auth-design.md' trust.json
! grep notes/architecture/auth-runbook.md trust.json

# stale only returns the expired runbook
exec sh -c 'pinax search auth --stale only --vault vault --json > stale.json'
validate-json-envelope stale.json
grep 'notes/architecture/auth-runbook.md' stale.json

# search show detail card: trust panel + links + snippet, no body leak
exec sh -c 'pinax search show notes/architecture/auth-design.md --vault vault --json > show.json'
validate-json-envelope show.json
validate-clean-stdout show.json
grep '"tier":"human"' show.json
grep '"latest_human_by":"human:ye"' show.json
grep '"outgoing":1' show.json
grep token show.json
! grep 'full body marker that must not leak' show.json

# browse read-only: --lazy-index off must not write .pinax/index.sqlite
rm vault/.pinax/index.sqlite
exec sh -c 'pinax browse notes/architecture --lazy-index off --vault vault --json > browse.json'
validate-json-envelope browse.json
validate-clean-stdout browse.json
grep '"notes":3' browse.json
! exists vault/.pinax/index.sqlite

# browse error path: unknown folder fails closed with available folders
! exec sh -c 'pinax browse notes/nonexistent --vault vault --json > browse_missing.json'
grep browse_path_not_found browse_missing.json
grep notes/architecture browse_missing.json
